runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No promotion-grade new LIVE candidate was found. A fresh worldwide Upwork WordPress/WooCommerce technical role was verified but rejected as too server/PHP/MySQL-heavy and already 50+ proposals. LinkedIn NTU IT Support was rejected by hard locality gate because the actual workplace is Warsaw, Poland, despite Bratislava indexing. LIVE jobs-data remains fail-closed because safe complete round-trip replacement is unavailable.

developmentChanges.title: Indexed location vs actual workplace guard
developmentChanges.reason: Parse the actual workplace from the full job detail and override search-result/indexed city when they conflict. This prevents false Bratislava hits such as roles indexed under Bratislava whose real workplace is Warsaw or another distant city.

developmentChanges.title: Proposal saturation decay
developmentChanges.reason: Apply a rapidly increasing ranking penalty to freelance jobs after 20, 50 and 100 proposals, with a smaller penalty when the client is actively interviewing. This saves application time on technically suitable but already saturated jobs.
